Scene:
发现了夹竹桃有毒。别人看到他，很快给他吃一个灵芝。神农一吃就觉得比较好。然后，他继续写他发现的信息。会告诉他的朋友哪一个植物能不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 发现了夹竹桃有毒：it is unclear that夹竹桃refers to黄色的花
- 别人看到他：另外一个人，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”
- 会告诉他的朋友哪一个植物能不能吃：也会告诉他的朋友哪一个植物能吃，哪个植物不能吃

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 写他发现的信息：写下他发现的信息，The verb needs to express recording the information he discovered; the result complement makes clear that he puts the information into writing. [vocab list]
Run 2: 写他发现的信息：写下他发现的信息，写 means to write or compose, while 写下 means to record information so it is kept. [vocab list]
Run 3: 写：写下，Use this verb when recording discovered information so that it is kept in writing. [vocab list]

output.reason: All runs identify the use of 写 for recording information and consistently correct it to 写下.
